pr_title: Fix expanded beatmap cards sometimes being hidden by next profile section

issue_context.title: Difficulty dropdown on profile pages getting covered by Kudosu section
issue_context.body: ### Type Cosmetic ### Bug description When visiting a user's profile and scrolling down to their graveyarded beatmaps and hovering over the beatmap, the difficulty box ends up getting cut off. This box ends up behind the Kudosu section when it probably makes more sense to have it cover the Kudosu section while the user is hovering over the beatmap. The border is slightly cut off behind the Kudosu section The difficulty section is mostly hidden behind the Kudosu section. I experienced this behavior on my MacBook Pro with an M1 Pro chip (using Apple Silicon release). ### Screenshots or videos https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67621489/206108239-ec343332-0aea-4526-bc6c-323f51a6c793.mp4 ### Version 2022.1205.0-lazer ### Logs [logs.zip](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/10173490/logs.zip)

review_comments:
`flowChildren` is enumerated thrice in this method. The underlying `FlowingChildren` includes two live order-by calls, so I *believe* this may end up re-sorting every time?

Maybe worth materialising this collection here?
I saw this but the overhead didn't *seem* too bad (could not notice on frame graph). Likely due to number of sections being very limited in all cases.
